title: V2 survival data preparation (nb13)
description: Frozen v1.3'ten leakage-safe time-to-next-service survival episode'ları; sağ-sansürlü kayıtlar korunuyor; strict-temporal censoring + informative-censoring audit. Henüz predictive model yok.

title: V2 survival baseline models (nb14)
description: Kaplan-Meier reference vs Cox PH vs Random Survival Forest on 41.518 episode. Champion Cox: TEST IPCW C-index 0.895, IBS 0.058. SURVIVAL SIGNAL STRONG. Ready for nb15.

title: V2 advanced survival models (nb15)
description: CoxNet / XGBoost survival:cox / survival:aft tuned + per-horizon IPCW-isotonic calibrated. Champion ENSEMBLE[XGB_COX+COXNET]: TEST IPCW C-index 0.913, IBS 0.049, Brier@90 0.050. STRONG IMPROVEMENT vs Cox baseline; V2 signal STRONG; V2 MODELING COMPLETE.

title: V2 survival model packaged for inference (nb16)
description: Frozen FULL/FINAL ensemble packaged as ridebase_ml.v2.V2SurvivalPredictor + /api/v2/* + Control Center module. Notebook-vs-production golden parity: PASS. 8 SHA256-verified artifacts. Verdict: READY FOR PILOT DEPLOYMENT. Real-fleet validation PENDING.

title: V1 production dashboard (FastAPI + Next.js)
description: Leakage-safe prediction API + analytics dashboard; frozen modelleri transform-only kullanır.

title: RideBase ML Control Center
description: EDA + V0 + V1 modüllerini tek merkezi yönetim panelinde birleştiren sistem (bu artifact).

title: V2 LIVE PREDICTION REDESIGNED
description: Brand→model selection, deterministic model-spec mapping and honest partial-snapshot inference replaced the previous example-snapshot overlay approach.

title: V2.0 live-scenario audit failed
description: Service-event landmark mismatch, 30d exact-zero collapse, km insensitivity, elapsed-time reversal, absolute-year drift, observation-window artifact sensitivity and overdue contradiction reproduced. V2.0 retained only as a synthetic research baseline.

title: V1.4 event generator + V2.1 dynamic-landmark dataset rebuilt
description: V1.3 reused a fixed service-row sequence, collapsing heavy-overdue future-event probability. V1.4 produces a continuing stochastic service-event process (source schema unchanged). V2.1 landmarks rebuilt on V1.4: 256,841 landmarks / 8,907 motorcycles / 208,746 events / 48,095 right-censored / 54 features. Data gate PASS — leakage, censoring, calendar-invariance, km/days-due coherence, unseen-motorcycle isolation.

title: V2.1 dynamic-landmark survival model — Phase 3 PASS
description: Ladder: OEM rule → simple Cox → Cox PH → CoxNet → XGB-Cox. Champion xgb_cox (monotone-constrained) + isotonic calibration, selected on VALIDATION only; TEST read once after freeze. Frozen TEST: IPCW C-index 0.7527, IBS 0.1020, Brier@30 0.0835. P30 exact-zero 0.000 (126 levels) — V2.0's 30d collapse, km flatness, elapsed-time reversal and absolute-year cliff are all gone. Behaviour + 30-day health gates PASS.

title: V2.1 predictor + /api/v2_1/* packaged
description: ridebase_ml.v2_1.V21SurvivalPredictor + separate /api/v2_1/* routes (model/info, features, metrics, sample, predict, predict/batch, predict/scenario). V1 and V2.0 routes untouched, /api/v2/* not redirected. Golden parity over 4000 frozen TEST rows: max probability delta 8.30e-06, deterministic, horizons monotone → PASS. Real-fleet validation PENDING.

title: Beginner-friendly metric explanations and terminology added
description: Control Center'ın her modülüne 'Bu sayfa ne anlatıyor?' kutusu, teknik terimlerin Türkçe karşılığı, ⓘ tooltip'leri, 'Teknik detay' accordion'ları ve TR sözlük (docs/ml_glossary_tr.md) eklendi. R²/C-index/AUC hiçbir yerde 'doğruluk yüzdesi' olarak yazılmıyor.

title: Public V1/V2 inference API — deploy blueprint prepared
description: render.yaml + Dockerfile.prod (ridebase_ml paketi + artifactlar bundle) + runtime API-URL config (?v2api= / RIDEBASE_V2_API) hazır. Gerçek public deployment BLOCKED_BY_PROVIDER_AUTH — provider hesabı gerekiyor; sahte online API gösterilmiyor.

title: Dedicated beginner-friendly V1 live prediction added
description: V1 Regression → Canlı Tahmin ekranı gerçek /api/v1/sample + /api/v1/predict akışını kullanır. Demo sonucu gerçek frozen modelden gelir ve açıkça örnek motor olarak etiketlenir. Kişisel gerçek-motor girdisi, servis geçmişinden deterministik feature türetme hattı bağlanana kadar tahmin üretmez.
